mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM delivery WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT DATE_SUB(a.started_at, INTERVAL (SECOND(a.started_at) * 1000000 + MICROSECOND(a.started_at)) MICROSECOND) AS minute, SUM(a.status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299) AS ok, SUM(a.status_code IS NULL OR a.status_code NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299) AS failed FROM delivery_attempt a JOIN delivery d ON d.id = a.delivery_id WHERE a.started_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute
